clauses.statement: Every test/**/*.{test,spec}.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,cjs,mjs} file whose source references mkdtemp or os.tmpdir() must import test/support/scratch-tmpdir.js; a conformance test enumerates all such files and fails, naming every offender, when any of them omits the import.
clauses.rationale: Without a deterministic conformance guard, new test files reintroduce the same $TMPDIR fixture leak the helper was built to close, since the leak is invisible until fixtures accumulate over many runs.

story_refs.text_snippet: AC1: mkdtempを使う全テストファイルがscratch隔離ヘルパーをimportし
AC3: 回帰ガード: mkdtemp/os.tmpdir()を参照するテストファイルがヘルパーをimportしていない場合に失敗するconformanceテストが存在する

architecture_refs.text_snippet: test/ 配下123ファイル + src/ 4ファイルがmkdtempを使用し、prefixは約400種

test_refs.case: GATE conformance: every test/**/*.test.js file that uses mkdtemp/os.tmpdir imports the scratch-tmpdir helper

clauses.statement: Given a process that imports test/support/scratch-tmpdir.js, when that process (or any code it runs in-process, or any child process it spawns via inherited environment variables) calls mkdtemp against os.tmpdir(), then the resulting directory is created inside a per-process vibepro-scratch- root under the real $TMPDIR, and that scratch root no longer exists once the process exits normally.
clauses.rationale: The helper only redirects fixtures safely if the redirection covers test-helper mkdtemp calls, in-process src code mkdtemp calls, and spawned child processes (e.g. git) alike, and cleans up on exit; otherwise fixtures keep leaking through whichever path is uncovered.

story_refs.text_snippet: AC1: テストプロセス正常終了時にそのプロセスが作ったfixtureディレクトリがホストの実$TMPDIR直下に残らない
AC2: 隔離はテスト内で呼ばれるsrc本体のmkdtempと、テストがspawnする子プロセス(git等)にも及ぶ(環境変数継承で保証)

architecture_refs.text_snippet: os.tmpdir()は呼び出しごとにTMPDIRを読む(Node実測済)ため、テストヘルパー経由・src本体経由・子プロセス経由のmkdtempすべてがscratch rootに閉じる

test_refs.case: GATE behavioral: importing the helper redirects mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()) into a private scratch root that is removed on exit

clauses.statement: Given a vibepro-scratch- directory left in the real $TMPDIR with an mtime older than 24 hours (e.g. from a process killed before its exit handler ran), when any process imports test/support/scratch-tmpdir.js, then that stale directory is removed as part of the helper's self-healing sweep at import time.
clauses.rationale: SIGKILL or other abnormal termination bypasses the process.once('exit') cleanup, so without a startup sweep, crashed test runs would still accumulate fixtures indefinitely and reproduce the original ENOSPC failure.

story_refs.text_snippet: AC4: クラッシュ残骸の自己回復: 24時間以上前のscratch root残骸をヘルパー起動時に掃除する

architecture_refs.text_snippet: SIGKILL等でexitフックが走らないケースは、ヘルパーが起動時に24時間以上前の自前prefixのscratch rootを掃除する自己回復で補う

test_refs.case: GATE behavioral: the self-healing sweep removes stale vibepro-scratch-* directories on import

diagrams.title: Scratch-root lifecycle
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> no_scratch_root
    no_scratch_root --> active: import test/support/scratch-tmpdir.js (mkdtemp scratch_root, TMPDIR redirected)
    active --> active: test_process or child_process calls mkdtemp against real_tmpdir path (now scratch_root)
    active --> no_scratch_root: test_process exits normally (process.once('exit') removes scratch_root)
    no_scratch_root --> stale: test_process killed before exit handler runs (scratch_root left behind, mtime ages)
    stale --> no_scratch_root: next helper import sweeps vibepro-scratch-* dirs older than 24h (sweepStaleScratchDirs)

diagrams.title: TMPDIR fixture cleanup failure and abuse surfaces
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[test_process starts] --> B{Does it import scratch-tmpdir helper?}
    B -- no --> C[mkdtemp writes directly to real_tmpdir - conformance test fails]
    B -- yes --> D[TMPDIR redirected to per-process scratch_root]
    D --> E{Process terminates}
    E -- normal exit --> F[process.once('exit') removes scratch_root]
    E -- SIGKILL or crash --> G[scratch_root left behind, mtime ages past 24h]
    G --> H[next helper import sweeps vibepro-scratch-* prefixed dirs older than 24h]
    H --> I[Non-vibepro-scratch- content in real_tmpdir is never touched by the sweep]
    D --> J[child_process spawned by test_process inherits redirected TMPDIR env var]
    J --> K[child_process mkdtemp calls also land inside the same scratch_root]
    D --> L{Concurrent test_process instances}
    L --> M[Each test_process gets its own mkdtemp-created scratch_root - no cross-process deletion of live roots]
    D --> N[rmSync uses force+recursive inside try/catch]
    N --> O[Cleanup failure never throws or breaks the running tests]
